title: Microduck - the head (mj_host --head-graph)
launch_hint: loaded beside a level-2 brain: ogma_mjhost --level2 ... --head-graph <config> [--head-joints]
description: The head brain (mj_host/src/HeadAdapter.cpp): its own bus and inspector (port +2), sensing the four head joints, the trunk IMU and a 12-slot head sense, commanding the head joints. With --head-joints its commands are written to the servos directly; without it they ride the walking policy's head block.

sources.name: head
sources.description: the four head joints [neck pitch, head pitch, head yaw, head roll] relative to home, in the policy's command units

sources.name: head_sense
sources.description: the load slots: head roll, head pitch, down-shortfall (all ~0 level), head gyro x0.3 (3), trunk gravity x, y, trunk gyro x0.3 (3), 11 = the gaze error /yaw range with --head-gaze-sense (the host's gaze target: the seek target, a mover, or with --look-around the bearing least recently seen; minus the head's yaw)

sinks.name: neck_pitch
sinks.description: neck pitch command, unit-scaled to the head range

sinks.name: head_yaw
sinks.description: head yaw command (masked unless the config drives it)

events.name: reset
events.description: fired when the recovery harness stands the body back up
